run_python_code: run a Python code snippet with timeout, cwd, and optional stop signal support
run_bash_command: run a bash or powershell command with streaming stdout and timeout enforcement
scan_web_page: scan the current browser tab for simplified HTML content and list all open tabs
execute_browser_js: execute JavaScript in the browser to fully control page interactions and capture results
read_file_content: read a file starting from a given line with keyword search and line number display
